tool_input.command:
cd /workspace/task && python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
for r in range(2,21):
    ws.cell(r,18).value = '=IF(ISERROR(S{r}),\"Upload\",IF(AND(U{r}>=-1,U{r}<=1),\"Do not Upload\",\"to Check\"))'.format(r=r)
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('saved')
"
